name: HEXTECH
recent: Hextar Technologies Solutions 正在推进以 280 万令吉向 Hextar Holdings 出售全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse 的提案，并已发出股东通函及召开特别股东大会的通知。与此同时，公司首席执行官兼执行董事 Dato' Ong Choo Meng 在闭市期内外均有股份买卖申报。最新季度财报显示营收环比下降 18.0%，但净亏损收窄至 570 万令吉。
notable: 拟以 280 万令吉向 Hextar Holdings 出售全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse，已发出股东通函并将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日召开特别股东大会寻求批准。
risks: 大股东 Hextar Holdings 在 2026 年 10 月 27 日至 28 日及 11 月 19 日于公开市场及直接交易中出售股份。
公司最新季度仍录得净亏损 570 万令吉。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3286 万令吉，环比下降 18.0%，但同比增长 23.3%；净亏损 570 万令吉，净亏损率从上一季度的 48.5% 收窄至 17.3%。

Hextar Holdings Sdn Bhd entered into Share Sale Agreement to acquire Guper Bonded Warehouse Sdn Bhd from Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad for MYR 2.8 million.

recent_en: Hextar Technologies Solutions is proceeding with the proposed disposal of its wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse to Hextar Holdings for MYR 2.8 million, having issued a circular and EGM notice. Meanwhile, CEO and Executive Director Dato' Ong Choo Meng has reported both acquisitions and disposals of shares during and outside the closed period. The latest quarterly results show revenue down 18.0% QoQ, while net loss narrowed to MYR 5.7 million.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse to Hextar Holdings for MYR 2.8 million; circular issued and EGM set for 24 November 2026 to seek approval.
CEO and Executive Director Dato' Ong Choo Meng reported multiple acquisitions and disposals of company shares between October and November 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Hextar Holdings sold shares in the open market and via direct business transactions on 27-28 October and 19 November 2026.
The company remained in net loss of MYR 5.7 million in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 32.86 million, down 18.0% QoQ but up 23.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 5.7 million, with net margin improving from negative 48.5% in the prior quarter to negative 17.3%.
